cases.prompt: Construct a Himalaya command to list envelope metadata from Sent, page 1, with 20 results per page and JSON output. Do not run it. Return only a JSON object with an argv array of strings, starting with the executable. Put folder, page, page size, and output flags in that order after the subcommand.

Construct a Himalaya command to list envelope metadata from the fictional folder Project Updates with JSON output. Do not run it. Return only a JSON object with an argv array of strings, starting with the executable. Place the folder flag and its value before the output flag; preserve the entire folder name as one argument.

A fictional Himalaya envelope listing returned exit code 1 and 'IMAP authentication failed: credentials rejected'. Explain why the listing failed and whether any messages were retrieved, using only JSON fields reason and messages_retrieved. Set reason to one of authentication_failed, folder_missing, or success, and messages_retrieved to a boolean.
